sense: the capital of the United States

terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Vashintōniam (to), Vashintōniae (at), Vashintōniā (from). Traupman uses the name for the capital and the state alike.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
